game.desc: Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Fate of Two Worlds is a 2D fighting game for Xbox 360. You will find forty characters from comic books or video games such as Iron Man, Dante or Viewtiful Joe. The combat system is enhanced with new features such as Team Aerials Combos, a combo to be performed by several players, or the X-factor, which allows you to regain punch in a critical state.
